system.asr.ui.asr_hint: Enable, then hold F8 (remappable in Controls) to record and release to finish. In game this opens the assistant; in an assistant screen it preserves your draft. The Voice input button and /listen also work. Recording ends after at most 60 seconds. By default, final text enters the draft and Enter sends it. Enable Send after recognition to automatically send the final result together with any existing draft. All changes are saved automatically. Choose the language/model in the NLS project console (16 kHz). Estimated price: CNY 3.5 per 1,000 successful calls; server pricing config applies.
system.asr.ui.asr_note: Recognition starts disabled. NLS needs its own project AppKey and temporary Token, separate from the DashScope TTS key. Saved credentials stay in this client's config/system/system-asr.json as plain text; blank fields use ALIYUN_NLS_APP_KEY / ALIYUN_NLS_TOKEN.

system.result.help:
[Command manual] Available instructions, Host:
/select <number> or “select 1”: execute an option in the current reply
/usage: open AI / TTS / ASR usage (administrators can view all players)
/mode simple or /mode full: switch views
/ai on|off: enable or disable external AI
/memory on|off: enable or disable server conversation storage
/forget: clear conversation memory
/history: view history (full view only)
/settings: unified settings (General / Speech output / Voice input); use /system settings in game chat
/listen: voice input; automatic sending is available in settings
/close or Esc: return to the game

Administrators can use /system grant [player] to bind, /system revoke [player] to revoke and clear business records, or /system reset [player] to clear old-format records before binding again; cumulative AI / TTS / ASR usage is retained. Query commands also work as /system shop or /system item minecraft:torch.

system.tts.ui.cache_enabled: Reuse previously synthesized speech (off by default)
system.tts.ui.cache_hint: Store complete utterances in config/system/tts-cache (up to 64 MiB / 256 entries). Matching text, model, voice and language reuse local audio without an API call. Incomplete synthesis is not cached. Audio remains on disk when this option is off; delete the folder to clear it.
system.tts.ui.notification_sound_hint: On by default. Plays when the notification panel first opens, without repeating between queued messages. Independent of automatic speech; no API key required. Uses 75% of speech volume. Turning it off keeps body narration available.
system.tts.ui.quest_hint: With details off, read only the name and rewards (reward speech has its own switch). Details adds objectives; background also needs its switch. Empty descriptions and instructions are skipped; no story is invented. Decisions are cached server-side by quest ID and language. External AI off prevents requests. Queries and narration never submit quests; send submit <number or name> explicitly.
